system_configurations.name: RCCL-GIN-rocSHMEM-Backends-MI455X
system_configurations.description: GIN Anvil SDMA reach across hosts on MI455X: MixedBackends_TwoNodeUnsetType on a rocSHMEM-GIN build, with and without the fabric pod opt-ins.

gin_devmpi_pod_2node.description: AICOMRCCL-3444: 2 hosts, NCCL_GIN_TYPE unset (not empty), no pod opt-ins. Anvil SDMA must be removed at the host boundary.

tests.name: MixedBackends_TwoNodeUnsetType
tests.description: Anvil SDMA reach on a 2-host comm: removed without the pod opt-ins, kept inside one pod with both

gin_devmpi_pod_2node_optin.description: AICOMRCCL-3444: as gin_devmpi_pod_2node with both pod opt-ins. Inside one pod Anvil SDMA must stay and carry the put/signal.

test_suites.name: GIN Device MPI Tests - MI450 pod, no opt-ins (2 nodes, type unset)
test_suites.description: NCCL_GIN_TYPE unset, pod opt-ins unset: Anvil SDMA is removed and PROXY is the default

test_suites.name: GIN Device MPI Tests - MI450 pod, both opt-ins (2 nodes, type unset)
test_suites.description: NCCL_GIN_TYPE unset, RCCL_GIN_ANVIL_FABRIC_POD=1 and RCCL_GIN_ANVIL_FABRIC_MEM=1: Anvil SDMA stays across the 2 hosts
